# espalier_image_build (Resource)

An image built from a Dockerfile with the runtime's builder (`container build`). It is rebuilt in place, under the same tags, when the build context, the Dockerfile, the arguments that shape the image or `triggers` change, and when a tag is removed or moved outside Terraform. See the provider's `builder` settings for the builder container.

Containers that use the image by tag are not recreated by a rebuild; add `replace_triggered_by` on its `digest` to them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "espalier_image_build" "app" {
  context    = "${path.module}/app"
  tags       = ["app:dev"]
  build_args = { GO_VERSION = "1.25" }

  # Read from the host when building; never stored in the state.
  secrets = { npm_token = { env = "NPM_TOKEN" } }

  # Rebuilds happen when the context changes; bump this to force one.
  triggers = { rebuild = "1" }
}

resource "espalier_container" "app" {
  name  = "app"
  image = espalier_image_build.app.id

  # A rebuild keeps the tag, so recreate the container on a new digest.
  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [espalier_image_build.app.digest]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `context` (String) Build context directory, e.g. `"${path.module}/app"`.
- `tags` (List of String) References to build the image as, resolved like `espalier_image`'s `name`.

### Optional

- `build_args` (Map of String) Build-time variables (`ARG`).
- `dockerfile` (String) Path of the Dockerfile; a relative path is relative to `context`. Defaults to `Dockerfile` in `context`. It may be outside `context`.
- `hash_context` (Boolean) Rebuild when the content of `context` changes, by hashing it on every plan. Exclude large directories it need not read in a `.dockerignore`, or set `false` and rebuild with `triggers`. Defaults to `true`.
- `keep_locally` (Boolean) Keep the image's tags in the runtime when the resource is destroyed or a tag is removed from `tags`. Defaults to `false`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels added to the image.
- `no_cache` (Boolean) Build without the builder's cache. Changing it does not rebuild.
- `platforms` (List of String) Platforms to build for (`os/arch[/variant]`), e.g. `["linux/arm64", "linux/amd64"]` for a multi-platform image. Defaults to the host's.
- `pull` (Boolean) Pull base images even if they are present. Changing it does not rebuild.
- `secrets` (Attributes Map) Secrets the build can mount (`RUN --mount=type=secret,id=…`), by ID, read from a host environment variable or file when building. Their values never pass through Terraform, so changing one does not rebuild: change `triggers` to rebuild. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secrets))
- `ssh` (Boolean) Forward the host's SSH agent to the build (`RUN --mount=type=ssh`).
- `target` (String) Stage to build. Defaults to the last.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that rebuild the image when they change, e.g. `{ rebuild = "2" }` to force a rebuild, or a hash of something the build fetches.

### Read-Only

- `context_hash` (String) Hash of the Dockerfile and the context, if `hash_context` is set.
- `digest` (String) Digest of the built image index.
- `id` (String) Fully qualified reference of the first tag, e.g. `docker.io/library/app:dev` for `app:dev`.

### Nested Schema for `secrets`

Optional:

- `env` (String) Name of an environment variable of the Terraform process.
- `file` (String) Path of a file.
